recent_incidents.summary: Chad Williams, 24, opened fire outside the restaurant, faced return fire from an armed citizen and an off-duty police officer, and shot himself to death.
Cain Clark, 17, and Caleb Vasquez, 18, attacked a mosque and then died by self-inflicted gunshots as police responded.

Ndiaga Diagne, 53, opened fire in a popular entertainment district along Sixth Street, and was quickly killed in a gun battle with police. Diagne had emigrated to the US in 2000 and became a naturalized citizen in 2013.

Claudio Neves Valente, 48, a former student at Brown, opened fire inside the school of engineering, killing two victims and injuring nine others; two days later he shot and killed an MIT professor, who had been his former classmate in Portugal. After a six-day regional manhunt and a key tip from a reddit user, authorities found Neves Valente, dead from a self-inflicted gunshot wound, in a storage rental facility in New Hampshire.

Thomas J. Sanford, 40, an ex-Marine and Iraq War veteran, crashed his truck into a Mormon church during crowded Sunday morning services. He opened fire with a semiautomatic rifle and also carried out an arson attack on the building, before dying in a gun battle with responding police.
Nigel Edge (formerly Sean DeBevoise), 39, an ex-Marine and decorated Iraq war veteran, opened fire from a boat at the waterfront establishment; was arrested the following day by local authorities.
